release_scope: Niche-specific multi-page website generation for all six starters, shared brand-aware page shell, functional customer journeys, per-client navigation and catalog routes, generated client examples and handovers.

functional_flows.furniture: Shop or collection → product detail → material/size/color variants → client-specific persistent enquiry bag → checkout → WhatsApp/email enquiry
functional_flows.retail_and_grocery: Shop or collection → product detail → client-specific persistent cart and wishlist → cart → checkout → WhatsApp/email enquiry
functional_flows.food: Menu page, food product detail, and generated order page share the same food-order cart. Product detail supports size/serving and add-on selections; reservation/catering/contact pages send enquiries rather than confirm bookings.
